stable.notes: The Tasks pane kept only what was due, so a server holding captured rows and nothing scheduled reported "No open tasks". It shows every open row now, ranked so the newest capture is never pushed out by history. The domain picker reads the domains your COS actually has instead of four names baked into the app; on an older server it derives them from your own board rather than emptying itself. Pairs with server 6.44.2.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
